subject: QBR prep: account-by-account stitch, forecasts & prioritization
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: QBR prep: account-by-account stitch, forecasts & prioritization

Team —

QBR window is two weeks out. I want a tight, actionable package for the exec readout: a consolidated forecast sheet, one-pager summaries for the top 12 accounts, and a prioritized list of accounts where we should push for commit or risk-manage the forecast.

Please deliver the following by EOD Friday (2027-12-03):
- Updated row in Forecast_rollup_2027Q4.xlsx with confidence band (commit / best case / upside) and primary risk reason.
- One-pager (single slide) per account for Acme, Nimbus, and the other top 10 (use QBR_account_onepagers_v2 template). Keep asks explicit (PO timing, technical blockers, exec alignment).
- Short prioritization note (top 6 accounts) with recommended next-step (e.g., legal expedite, exec intro, price protection).

I’m copying Karthik for any field-level gating and Laura for risk tags. If you need me to join calls with any C-levels during the week, comment below with times.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Strategy (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-02T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: QBR prep: account-by-account stitch, forecasts & prioritization

Irene —

Uploading my first pass this morning. Highlights:
- Forecast_rollup_2027Q4.xlsx (attached) contains my commit / best / upside bands for the coverage book. I've marked Acme as "at-risk" in the commit column due to procurement timing; best-case still shows close this quarter if PO is signed by 12/12.
- Attached one-pager for Acme (QBR_account_onepagers_v2.pdf). Key ask: expedited SOW signing + a 3-week pilot payment to secure slot on Dedicated.
- Prioritization: 1) Acme, 2) Nimbus, 3) TerraCloud, 4) Fathom Health, 5) Byteware, 6) Kinetix. Rationale is in a folded note column in the rollup.

Open items: I don't have updated legal redline timing for Acme SOW — legal says 5 business days after receiving the procurement PO (they expect it by 12/09). Marcus, can you confirm the technical slot availability if Acme requests Dedicated start on 12/20?

-Marissa
Sr. AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Forecast_rollup_2027Q4.xlsx, QBR_account_onepagers_v2.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-03T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: QBR prep: account-by-account stitch, forecasts & prioritization

Marissa / Irene —

Quick tech check: if Acme wants Dedicated to start 12/20, we have a narrow window for capacity grooming. Ops can pull a 2-node pool and prioritize their model if we get SOW signed by 12/14. That matches Marissa's ask but requires immediate confirmation of model size and KV/cache expectations (I flagged this in the one-pager).

I've added a short account snapshot inline to Forecast_rollup_2027Q4.xlsx (column: tech_ready_flag = "yellow") and a recommended mitigation: offer a 2-week bridge on hosted with reserved burst on Dedicated day-1. That will preserve runway even if the SOW slips a week.

Also adding: for Nimbus procurement, we should push for a standard data processing addendum signed now — otherwise legal will stall on our enterprise clause. Laura, can you open a risk tag for Nimbus (procurement hold)?

Thanks,
Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer

Attachment: none (see updated rollup from Marissa)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-04T09:48:00Z
Subject: Re: QBR prep: account-by-account stitch, forecasts & prioritization

Team —

I've opened risk tags and added color-coded reasons in the rollup:
- Acme: procurement timing / SOW redline (RED)
- Nimbus: DPA / compliance hold (ORANGE)
- TerraCloud: internal budget gating (YELLOW)

Attached is a single-slide for Nimbus that calls out the compliance gating and suggested pre-approved template for DPA. For Acme I added an "exec ask" bullet to request Redwood's CCO to join the 12/08 call.

Irene, I'll also draft a short note you can use in the exec readout that summarizes top 3 runway risks and the mitigation plan.

- Laura
Director, Sales Operations

Attachments: Nimbus_onepager.pdf

From: J. Taylor <j.taylor@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-06T13:17:00Z
Subject: Re: QBR prep: account-by-account stitch, forecasts & prioritization

Marissa / Irene —

Thanks for the one-pager. Quick clarification: procurement expects to issue the PO the week of 12/06 but the exec signing authority is traveling and may not approve until 12/13. We really want the Dedicated start in the second half of December but can also accept the hosted-bridge option.

We reviewed the SOW draft and proposed a single commercial change on pricing floors; we'll return a redlined SOW by EOD 12/07. Can Marissa confirm whether Redwood can hold the quoted slot if we sign the SOW by 12/14?

Regards,
J. Taylor
VP Engineering, Acme Corp

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, J. Taylor <j.taylor@acme.com>
Date: 2027-12-08T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: QBR prep: account-by-account stitch, forecasts & prioritization

Thanks everyone — excellent progress. Final plan and ask summary for the exec packet: 

1) Acme (Top priority) — commit assumption: PO by 12/14, SOW signed by 12/16. Action owners: Marissa to chase procurement (daily check-ins), Marcus to reserve 2-node slot with Ops (hold until 12/14), Laura to supply the exec note for the readout. If PO slips past 12/16, downgrade commit to "best" and push for hosted-bridge.

2) Nimbus — push DPA template; if signed by 12/10 we keep commit, else move to "at-risk". Action owners: Laura + Karthik.

3) Other top-6 — see Forecast_rollup_2027Q4.xlsx for recommended next steps; prioritize Kinetix & Byteware for targeted discount protection gating.

I attached the consolidated rollup and one-pagers to the shared drive link (see related_links). If there are no major objections, I’ll finalize the exec slide deck on 12/09 and circulate to leadership for a 12/10 dry run.

Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Strategy (interim)
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Forecast_rollup_2027Q4.xlsx, QBR_account_onepagers_v2.pdf, Nimbus_onepager.pdf
